# Deterministic representative sample of MoN/FutureComposer HVSC tunes.
#
# HVSC copyright tunes are NEVER committed -- these are file PATHS only.
# Enumerated with sidid (player == MoN/FutureComposer) over the full HVSC
# tree (4032 tunes), sorted, then sampled at a fixed stride to ~150 paths
# spanning every collection and a wide spread of load addresses (PSID+RSID).
# The corpus test (tests/test_corpus.py) resolves each path under $HVSC (or
# the fetch mirror) and asserts parse succeeds and detect() == DIRECT; it
# skips cleanly when a tune is unavailable.
